title: Respect other members.
body: Discuss ideas without personal attacks, harassment, discrimination, or threats. Be patient with newcomers and respect different opinions.

title: Keep posts relevant and useful.
body: Focus on Fire Emblem Heroes, related Fire Emblem discussions, or this website. Avoid spam, repeated posts, misleading titles, and unsolicited advertising.

title: Choose the appropriate flair.
body: Select the flair that best describes your post. [MOD] megathread flairs are reserved for Forum Moderators, Schedule Managers, and Head Admin.

title: Use the relevant megathread.
body: When an active thread exists, share banner pulls and summoning results in the Banner Megathread, Binding Worlds requests in the Binding World Megathread, and Forma advice in the Hall of Forms Megathread. Separate detailed analyses and showcases are welcome.

title: Include context in showcases and hero ideas.
body: Explain your unit’s build and skill choices. Aether Showcases should describe the team and strategy. New Hero Ideas should explain proposed weapons, skills, and effects.

title: Separate confirmed news from predictions.
body: Link the original source for announcements. Clearly label speculation, datamines, and unconfirmed rerun dates. Correct inaccurate information when you discover it.

title: Keep content appropriate.
body: Do not post explicit sexual content, graphic violence, malicious links, scams, or another person’s private information.

title: Credit creators and respect spoilers.
body: Credit artwork, guides, and other borrowed material with a source link. Respect restrictions on reposting. Warn readers about story spoilers, identify the game or book, and keep spoilers out of titles.

title: Do not promote cheating or account trading.
body: Do not share cheating tools, instructions for exploiting the game, or offers to sell, trade, or give away game accounts.

title: Respect moderation and platform rules.
body: Forum staff may request changes or remove or close discussions that break these rules. Do not evade moderation or impersonate staff. Posts and replies also remain subject to GitHub’s community guidelines.
